test_simulator_reset_with_objects: test that sim.reset restores agent position and rigid and articulated object state to initial values
test_multiagent_move_and_reset: test multi-agent movement and reset by stepping 10 agents with random actions then verifying reset state
test_create_and_remove_sensor: test creating a new camera sensor on an agent scene node and removing it from the simulator
test_object_template_editing: test registering loading and editing object templates then adding rigid objects to the simulator scene
test_render_sensors_explicit_list: test rendering an explicit subset of sensor wrappers and verifying observation output contains only requested sensors
